title: Agent tree
description: Coding agents as a process tree, with the rules Linux uses: every agent has a pid, a parent and exactly one state (working R, waiting or needs-you S, paused T, done or failed with an exit code); you are process 1 at the top. Selecting an agent shows its reach: what it steers (everything below it, in the one colour) and whom it reports to. Sockets between siblings, opened by a shared ancestor, and two agents in one file show on the rows. Keyboard: arrows move, Enter selects. An `actions` snippet renders the app's own Pause, Stop, Message inside the selected row.
